title: GitHub audit spine setup
summary: Adds a local-first GitHub audit spine with Dependabot, CodeQL, nightly SARIF scans, weekly deep-audit workflow, AI-ready issue/PR templates, Copilot guidance, audit labels, dry-run-first GitHub label bootstrap tooling, and path-limited push activation for schedule/manual workflows.
reason: Give GitHub and AI-assisted agents structured scanner outputs, triage surfaces, validation expectations, and bootstrap instructions without requiring a live GitHub remote in this checkout.
behavior_before: The repository had generated drift, unit, WebView, Tauri, release, package, and pre-commit guardrails, but no repo-tracked CodeQL/SARIF/Dependabot audit spine, AI audit issue forms, PR safety template, audit label definition, or local GitHub label bootstrap helper.
behavior_after: The repository has local-first GitHub audit automation and AI-facing triage surfaces. Existing drift CI now validates the audit-spine config, and GitHub label/project/MCP activation remains explicit and opt-in after a remote exists.
manual_validation: .\ops\scripts\dev\bootstrap-github-audit-spine.ps1 dry run - passed; no remote resolved, owner/repo placeholder printed, no GitHub writes made
PowerShell parser check for bootstrap-github-audit-spine.ps1 and check-github-audit-spine.ps1 - passed
change packet marked complete after targeted audit-spine validation
GitHub activation follow-up: added path-limited push triggers to audit-sarif.yml and deep-audit.yml so GitHub registers the schedule/manual workflows on push
mediapipeline.tools.dev.ai_guardrail preflight --no-run - passed; reported existing unrelated dirty worktree context
npx --yes js-yaml for new/changed .github YAML files - passed
validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed due 11 unrelated generated files not listed in any unreleased packet
rollback_plan: Remove the new GitHub audit workflows, Dependabot config, issue templates, PR template, Copilot instructions, audit label JSON, bootstrap runbook, and dev helper scripts; remove the audit-spine check from phase1-drift.yml; restore ROOT_SCRIPT_INVENTORY counts and rows; delete this change packet.
notes:
Dependabot update groups for Actions, npm, Cargo, and Python manifests.
CodeQL code scanning workflow for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust, and GitHub Actions.
Nightly/manual Ruff and Semgrep SARIF uploads.
Weekly/manual deep validation workflow using existing repo guardrails.
Audit SARIF and Deep Audit include path-limited push triggers for their own workflow files so GitHub registers them on setup pushes without running heavy scans on ordinary code pushes.
Adds audit-spine config check to existing drift workflow.

Implementation-ready AI fix task issue form.
